column1: # The pending ledger: (file, mode) pairs that cannot pass yet, so that a gate that runs before the parser is complete can still be green without scoring anything it has not earned.
# - a failing pair that no row names fails the gate;
# - a row that names a pair that now passes fails the gate (the ledger stays exact);
# - rows only leave the ledger, or are narrowed; a new failure is fixed, never added;
# - a row that names no pair fails the gate.
# A selector ending in / names every file under that directory; the mode is * or one mode.
# The ledger is empty when the parser is complete.
